registry_binding.reason: The registry file is sha256-bound by config/crypto_paper_runtime_v1.json and config/kr_paper_runtime_ratification_candidate_v1.json (POLICY_BINDING_DRIFT on any byte change) and by config/kr_first_paper_experiment_application.json. The PAPER-scope source amendment is therefore recorded here, bound to the registry's exact bytes, the same separate-additional-ratification pattern config/paper_runtime_normalization_v1.json and config/regime_semantic_freshness_policy_v1.json use. The registry's own sources list, weekday_inference_prohibited=true and conflict_or_missing_result are unchanged and re-required by the loader.

official_capture.date_rule: Mirror of market_data/krx_official_holiday_calendar.py: a date listed as an official closure is CLOSED; a date listed in the official early-close statement is OPEN_EARLY_CLOSE; Saturday/Sunday is CLOSED; any other date of a published year is OPEN_REGULAR. Any cross-check disagreement is UNKNOWN.

historical_two_source.rule: A date is a US session only when BOTH the Alpaca market calendar lists it AND SPY has an Alpaca IEX daily bar for it. A date neither source lists is CLOSED. One-source-only is UNKNOWN. Early close is recorded from the Alpaca calendar close time (13:00) and never inferred. A date outside either capture window is UNKNOWN.
